caption: The video captures a press test, a cylindrical steel platen pressing on a stack of bricks atop a yellow-and-black striped base, framed by striped poles and a camera. The platen, already touching the top dark brick, descends, shortening the column as the reddish and dark bricks bear the load. After a brief intact interval, a vertical crack opens in the upper reddish brick, soon matched by one in the lower brick as dust escapes. The reddish bricks split into fragments that detach, fall, and eject sideways while the middle crumbles into loose rubble. As the platen keeps pressing, the top dark brick remains under it, joined to the lower pile by a thin column of debris, with pieces blurring past the base. Fragments and dust accumulate on the base and rubble pile while the background poles, camera, and housing stay in place.
relations: The descending platen compresses the stack, shortening the column as the reddish and dark bricks bear the load.
Sustained pressure causes vertical cracks in the reddish bricks, which split into fragments that eject sideways and fall.
The middle section crumbles into loose rubble, while dust escapes and fragments accumulate on the striped base.
As the platen keeps pressing, the top dark brick remains under it, connected to the pile by debris.
